text: Chapter 13: The Water Tribe and Coenubia@The Thing in the Abandoned District
■Next Mission\nMove from Aquacity to\nSeabed to start.
You agree to help the councilors to earn their trust.\nFirst, go to the entrance to the seabed of Aquacity with\nthe Rana warriors!
According to the councilors, there is an intruder in the\nAbandoned District. Fight the monsters in the water and\nget there!
You proceed with the help of Oxystones.\nHowever, some monsters that are usually not here are\nseen too. Let's proceed with caution!
According to Aga and the others, the composition of the\nseawater is unusual and the monsters that appear come from\ndeeper zones. Be more careful than ever and proceed further!
Ghost-like monsters appear before you. According to the\nRana warriors, they are the legendary deep-sea dwellers.\nBeat them and climb to the top!
At the summit of the ruins, Don Profundo claims that it's\ntheir territory. First, beat them to find out why they\nare here!
[[N]]Go to the place to get under the water
